# gitea_actions_runners (Data Source)

Lists Actions runners for the selected scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitea_actions_runners" "example" {
  scope = "org"
  org   = "my-org"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `scope` (String) The Actions scope: `admin`, `user`, `org`, or `repo`.

### Optional

- `disabled` (Boolean) Filter runners by disabled state.
- `org` (String) The organisation name when `scope = "org"`.
- `repository` (String) The repository name when `scope = "repo"`.
- `repository_owner` (String) The repository owner when `scope = "repo"`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `runners` (List of Object) The matching Actions runners. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--runners))
- `total_count` (Number) The total number of runners returned.

<a id="nestedatt--runners"></a>
### Nested Schema for `runners`

Read-Only:

- `busy` (Boolean)
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `ephemeral` (Boolean)
- `id` (Number)
- `labels` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedobjatt--runners--labels))
- `name` (String)
- `status` (String)
